caption:
Cutting out every good thing to feel holy? That's not holiness. (1 Timothy 4:3–5 devotional)

Some think holiness means cutting off every good thing. Paul says the opposite: every gift of God is good, made holy by thanks. Guilt isn't more spiritual than gratitude.

📌 Save this for your quiet time this week
💬 Comment below — which good gift can you receive with thanks today?
